items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions John Hammond in the context of his relationship with Basie and Lester Young ('John Hammond really made efforts to try to regain his friendship', 'he's a big friend of Basie's'). The interviewee does not describe a personal interaction or relationship with Hammond himself.

ctx.x: Basie ended up with Benny Goodman and John Hammond behind him--
Well, that's the point, isn't it?
